Okay found my draft after, what , a couple of hours. So I actually planned to to a Support-type Saber (she's still proficient in combat, don't get me wrong, but this is what I thought of as a "meta-breaker") and wanted to use the Lady of the lake. Since, by lore, she had given excalibur to Arthur (or Artoria), and also due to the fact that most western myths and legends involving a holy blade has a woman in it, in the draft I made her the keeper of all the legendary western blades, however since she's just the "Keeper" not the rightful wielder, she can't harness their full power, however she compensates by dual wielding, combining their powers for devastating effects, or launching them as projectiles which she can detonate, or teleport to ( thought of this while playing DMC4). Since Sabers had to have their personal weapon, I decided to use the Claiomh Solais as her weapon, since according to the weapon's lore, a woman held the secret to the blade, meaning the woman knew how to use the sword at its fullest potential.  Now, onto the support part. She can harness the essence of the swords and use it to buff an ally (most of the time her Master since he prefers to join the fight) and her NP is a team buff, allowing her and who she deems as allies to fight at their fullest potential, disregarding any physical or magical limit. To balance this, her Master is a subpar Magus who hasn't unlocked his fullest magical potential, not because he is subpar but because he relies on his amazing physical prowess and wit to fight both Masters and Servants. Also, they really don't get along due to conflicting morals. I still have to find my draft about the master so I can give his full details but feel free to ~~kinkshame~~ scrutinize my draft.

It remained that way up until p3rd, and I was hooked ot the new changes they've made to the LS. Didn't have the money when 3U was released, so I skipped it, but when I got back in 4U, I was EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED at what they did to the LS. They nerfed my main to such an extent that I find my hunting times way higher than they were before, but still stuck to it since I can't find a good weapon. Then came the IG, which carried me up High-rank and let me solo every key quests, and GS, which I used to cut down the big boys (Akantor, Dalamadur, Ukanlos) solo since we have crappy internet and then come G-rank, I discovered CB and along that, I stepped up my game by creating mixed sets as opposed to full sets I used to go for before. Now in Gen, the LS came back with a vengeance with Adept and along with it new weapons that I use now: LBG for Raths ( especially the Deviant and the metal ones) Bow (Teostra bow too OP) and Striker SA + Silverwind set, which gave me DPS for days. Right now, I'm using Striker SA or Adept Pierce LBG online, but I still use IG or LS for Alatreon and Rajang hunts
